description: QASH Domain A benchmark baseline for regression gating
note: Baseline recorded from GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest runner. Performance on GitHub-hosted runners varies; a single data point must not trigger a hard fail. See ci.yml bench-gate job policy.

epoch_transition/advance_epoch_1_validat.note: Populate by running: cargo bench -p qash-consensus --no-default-features 2>&1 | tee benchmarks/criterion_output.txt

epoch_transition/advance_epoch_1024_vali.note: Populate after first stable-runner run. Update manually for intentional trade-offs.

regression_policy.rationale: GitHub-hosted runners are noisy. One data point must not block unrelated correctness work.
